descriptions.en: Model the ontology and manage its metrics, functions, actions, workflows and skills
descriptions.zh-CN: 建模本体，管理指标、函数、动作、流程与技能

descriptions.en: A graph of the owners' object types and relations: browse, select and go into modeling.
descriptions.zh-CN: 用属主的对象类型和关系画图，浏览、选择并进入建模。

descriptions.en: Define relationships and their endpoints between object types
descriptions.zh-CN: 定义对象类型之间的关系及其关联端点

descriptions.en: Every action of this domain: its definition, the definition its code derives, the explanation of that code, status and deletion.
descriptions.zh-CN: 本域的全部动作：定义、由代码推导的定义、代码解释，以及状态和删除。

descriptions.en: Explore how roles, processes, and capabilities relate
descriptions.zh-CN: 治理层与能力层涉及的全部对象画成一张图：主体拥有角色，角色可执行动作、可编写流程，流程指定动作，触发启动一次执行。颜色区分类别；选择节点查看它的关系。指标视图、函数与 Skill 画在流程对象一侧，因为模型中它们还没有与流程相连。
当前部署的 SDK 发行声明的组件。组件随发行增改，这一页只读：可以搜索和查看声明，不能新增、修改或删除。
descriptions.zh-TW: 目前部署的 SDK 發行聲明的組件。組件隨發行增改，這一頁唯讀：可以搜尋和查看聲明，不能新增、修改或刪除。
descriptions.en: The components the deployed SDK release declares. Components change with a release, so this page is read-only: search and read declarations; nothing is created, changed or deleted here.
The projections of this domain you can use. Select one to see what it reads, how it is configured, which operations its owner registered, and which panels use it.
descriptions.zh-CN: 本域里我能使用的投影。选中一条，看它读什么、怎么配置、属主登记了哪些操作，以及哪些面板在用它。

descriptions.en: The panels this domain grants you: name, owner, sharing scope and template use; each panel's source, style, members, usage and grants.
descriptions.zh-CN: 本域授予你使用的面板：名称、所属人、共享范围与模板用途，以及每个面板的源码、样式、成员、引用与授权。

descriptions.en: Every application visible in this domain, built-in and domain-built alike. Open one to see its identity, entries and the panels it uses.
descriptions.zh-CN: 本域可见的全部应用：内置的与域内建的同列。展开一行看它的身份、入口和用到的面板。

descriptions.en: The agents of this domain: choose one to read or change its name, avatar, instructions, model and skills, or create one.
descriptions.zh-CN: 本域的智能体：选中一个查看或修改它的名称、头像、提示词、模型和技能，也可以新建一个。

descriptions.en: Read functions keep a query package and column labels; write functions keep parameters and Python code. A name is edited once, here.
descriptions.zh-CN: 读函数维护查询逻辑包和列标签，写函数维护参数和 Python 代码；名称只在这里编辑一次。

descriptions.en: Maintain business rules and terminology, and review pending knowledge
descriptions.zh-CN: 维护业务规则与术语，审核待确认的知识

descriptions.en: Ratings and comments users give on query and analysis results
descriptions.zh-CN: 用户对问答与分析结果的评价和留言
